articles.summary: Explores how healthcare organizations can maximize the impact of technology investments Introduces a four-stage technology maturity framework to help hospitals benchmark progress and identify areas to prioritize Baxter International Inc. (NYSE:BAX), a global medtech leader, today announced the release of its 2026 Connected Hospital Report , offering new insights into how hospitals across the United States are leveraging technology investments to drive clinical and operational outcomes. Based on a survey of 150 information technology (IT) and nursing leaders, the report examines how hospitals are progressing along a “connected hospital” journey by identifying four distinct levels of technology maturity (early, developing, advancing and leading). This framework is designed to help hospitals benchmark progress, prioritize initiatives that reflect their current needs and opportunities, and identify practical focus areas to strengthen long-term impact.
